fields.System.Title: TRF-402 — Age and escalate overdue transfers
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a network planner, I want to be told when a transfer has not arrived on time, so that
stock lost in transit is found rather than sitting in a virtual location forever.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given a transfer past its expected arrival with outstanding quantity, then it appears
  • on an overdue list with its age.
  • - Given the check, then it runs daily.
  • - Given a transfer overdue beyond the escalation threshold, then an alert reaches a
  • person, not only a log.
  • - Given the overdue item, then the report shows quantity, value, origin, and destination
  • so it can be prioritised.
  • - Given an investigation is opened, then the transfer links to it via
  • [TRF-404](TRF-404-investigate-and-resolve.md).
  • - Given the report, then it never auto-adjusts or writes off anything.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | transfers, inventory |
| Tables | transfer_shipment, stock_balance |
| Risks | Stock lost in transit, permanently and silently ([doc 09 §9.1](../../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md)) |
| Tests | integration |
